propositions: tests/unit/test_build_provenance.py rebuilds identical clean-source wheel and sdist artifacts separately in four tests (35.93s baseline), with three tests repeating the same REBAR_BUILD_COMMIT=abc1234 build

Test module should share one session-scoped immutable wheel/sdist artifact per pytest worker built from git archive with python -m build, while install-from-sdist, empty-env failure, and rebuild-from-sdist remain distinct real builds in function-scoped contexts
Shared immutable artifacts must be consumed read-only; mutating extraction and rebuild work must occur in function-local copies to prevent cross-test state pollution

Deterministic build-call counting oracle must detect defects: duplicate prerequisite builds must fail the count check (expected 1, observed 2), and missing REBAR_BUILD_COMMIT in the wheel artifact must fail the provenance assertion
